info.name: ✅ Exam APIs - Numeric IDs Fixed (Unicode Safe)
info.description:
Fixed exam APIs using numeric IDs (fieldId, topicId, levelId) to solve Unicode encoding issues with Vietnamese characters. Response includes both numeric IDs and text names.

## Problem Solved
- ❌ Before: Text strings caused encoding errors ("Lập trình viên" → "L???p tr??nh vi??n")
- ✅ After: Numeric IDs are encoding-independent

## Key Changes
1. Database: Added field_id, topic_id, level_id columns
2. Request: Use numeric IDs instead of text strings
3. Response: Includes both IDs (for queries) and names (for display)

## Usage
1. Get available IDs: GET /questions/fields, /topics, /levels
2. Create exam: POST /exams/with-random-questions with numeric IDs
3. Verify: Response includes both fieldId and field name

item.name: 1. Create Empty Exam with Numeric IDs

request.description:
Create an empty exam with numeric IDs (optional). Response will include fieldId, topicId, levelId if provided.

Response format:
```json
{
  "id": 59,
  "fieldId": 1,
  "topicId": 1,
  "levelId": 2,
  "title": "Java Backend Developer Interview",
  "status": "DRAFT",
  "topics": [1, 2, 3],
  "questionTypes": [1, 2],
  "questionCount": 20,
  "duration": 60,
  "language": "vi"
}
```

✅ FIXED: Create exam with random questions using numeric IDs.

**What's Fixed:**
- Uses fieldId, topicIds, levelId (numeric) instead of text strings
- Stores numeric IDs in database (field_id, topic_id, level_id columns)
- No more Unicode encoding errors

**Response includes:**
- Numeric IDs: fieldId, topicIds, levelId, questionTypeId
- Text names: field, topics, level, questionType (for display)
- Both Vietnamese and English text display correctly

**Example Response:**
```json
{
  "examId": 57,
  "title": "Spring Boot Practice Exam",
  "status": "DRAFT",
  "duration": 45,
  "questionCount": 5,
  "questionIds": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
  "questions": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "fieldId": 1,
      "topicIds": [1],
      "levelId": 2,
      "questionTypeId": 1,
      "field": "Lập trình viên",
      "topics": ["Spring Boot"],
      "level": "Junior",
      "questionType": "Multiple Choice",
      "questionText": "What is Spring Boot?",
      "questionAnswer": "A framework..."
    }
  ]
}
```

item.name: 3. Add Random Questions to Exam (Numeric IDs)

request.description: Add random questions to an existing exam using numeric IDs. Uses ID-based queries to avoid Unicode encoding issues.
Update an existing exam with new numeric IDs. The system validates that the new IDs exist.
Search questions using numeric IDs. This is encoding-independent and works correctly with Vietnamese characters.

item.name: 6. Get Exam by ID (Verify Numeric IDs)

request.description:

**Expected Response:**
```json

  "id": 57,
  "userId": 1,
  "examType": "PRACTICE",
  "title": "Spring Boot Practice Exam",
  "position": "Java Developer",

  "topicId": 1,

  "questionTypes": [1, 2],
  "questionCount": 5,
  "duration": 45,
  "status": "DRAFT",
  "language": "vi",
  "createdAt": "2025-11-25T16:42:59.203",
  "createdBy": 1,
  "questions": [
    {
      "id": 2,
      "fieldId": 1,
      "topicIds": [1],
      "levelId": 2,
      "questionTypeId": 2,
      "field": "Lập trình viên",
      "topics": ["ReactJS"],
      "level": "Junior",
      "questionType": "Open Ended",
      "questionText": "Explain Virtual DOM",
      "questionAnswer": "Virtual DOM is..."
    }
  ]
}
```

**Verify:**
- ✅ fieldId, topicId, levelId are numeric (not null)
- ✅ field, topics, level display correctly (no L???p tr??nh vi??n)
- ✅ Questions include both IDs and names
Get list of available fields with their IDs. Use these IDs when creating exams.
Get list of available topics with their IDs. Use these IDs when creating exams.
Get list of available levels with their IDs. Use these IDs when creating exams.
